# 1 Enoch Chapter 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** Then God answered and spoke to me, and I heard his voice: "Do not be afraid, Enoch — righteous man, scribe of righteousness. Come close and listen.

**2** Go back and tell the Watchers of heaven who sent you here to intercede for them: 'You should have been interceding for humans — not the other way around.

**3** Why did you abandon the high, holy, eternal heaven and sleep with women? You defiled yourselves with human daughters, took wives for yourselves, acted like ordinary mortals, and fathered giants as your sons.

**4** You were holy — spiritual beings living in eternal life. But you contaminated yourselves with the blood of women. You fathered children in flesh and blood, and like mortals who die and decay, you craved physical bodies.

**5** I gave mortal humans wives so they could have children and lack nothing on earth — because they are mortal; that is their nature.

**6** But you were once spiritual beings living eternal, immortal lives, age after age.

**7** I never appointed wives for you. Spiritual beings belong in heaven — heaven is their home.

**8** But now — the giants born from the union of spirits and flesh will be called evil spirits on the earth. The earth will be their home.

**9** The evil spirits came out of their bodies. They are born from human women on one side and from the holy Watchers on the other — that is their origin, their nature. Evil spirits they are, and evil spirits they will always be called.

**10** The spirits of heaven live in heaven. The spirits of earth — born on earth — live on earth.

**11** And these spirits of the giants will harass, oppress, destroy, assault, make war, and cause devastation on the earth. They will not eat, but they will be hungry and thirsty, and they will cause people to sin.

**12** These spirits will rise up against the children of men and against women — because that is where they came from.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Chapter 15 is one of the most theologically dense chapters in all of 1 Enoch. God explains not just the verdict but the reason — the Watchers violated the ontological boundary between spiritual immortality and physical mortality. The result of this boundary violation is the origin of evil spirits from the giants' dead bodies (vv. 8–9, 11–12). The dynamic rendering gives each theological argument its own clear paragraph rhythm.*
